:::{.definition data-title="Martingale Differences"}

Let $(X_{n}, \mathcal{F}_{n})$ be a [[martingale-theory|martingale]]. The
sequence of martingale differences $\{  D_{n} \}_{n\geq 1}$ is defined by
$D_{n}=X_{n}-X_{n-1}$. Then
$$
X_{n}=X_{0}+\sum_{i=1}^n D_{i}.
$$

:::

- Note: $D_{n}$ is $\mathcal{F}_{n}$ measurable,
  $\mathbb{E}\lvert D_{n} \rvert < \infty$ and
  $\mathbb{E}[D_{n+1}|\mathcal{F}_{n}]=0$ for all $n$.
